The rests are dhamma, (but) not faultless dhamma. Un-faultless. Dhamma? Yes. Dhamma. Un-faultless? Un-faultless dhamma are both dhamma and un-faultless dhamma. The rests are dhamma, (but) not indeterminate dhamma. Negative (Paccan¯ika) 26. Not faultless. Not dhamma? With the exception of faultless, the rests are dhamma, (but) not faultless dhamma.
